<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="format"><label>Format</label></data>
        <data source="num episodes"><label>Episode count</label></data>
        <data source="num seasons"><label>No. of seasons</label></data>	
        <data source="runtime"><label>Run time</label></data>
        <data source="network"><label>Network(s)</label></data>
        <data source="first aired"><label>First aired</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{first aired|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{first aired|}}}}}|future||{{{first aired|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="last aired"><label>Last aired</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{last aired|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{last aired|}}}}}|future||{{{last aired|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data> 
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="creators"><label>Creator(s)</label></data>
        <data source="writers"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="directors"><label>Director(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="executive producers"><label>Executive producer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="production company"><label>Production company</label></data>	
        <data source="starring"><label>Starring</label></data>	
        <data source="music"><label>Music by</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:TelevisionSeries|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check=1|sort_key=S}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{{is_appearance|}}}|{{AppMediaCat}}|}}<noinclude>[[category:Television and video infoboxes]]
